title: Diamond Vault Account: Adding authorized users
summary: This document explains how to add authorized users to a Diamond Vault Account, including role-based access assignment, requiring approvals via the standard corporate governance workflow, and reviewing permissions after provisioning. It also covers ongoing governance: periodic access audits, separating initiation/approval duties, and maintaining an access register with roles/scopes/last review dates. The account tier has no cap on the number of authorized users.
faqs: What is the maximum number of authorized users I can add to a Diamond Vault Account tier?
